DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

Given the brief duration of your symptoms, lack of auditory changes, and normal neurological findings on initial assessment, this clinical picture strongly suggests BPPV rather than a central cause or Meniere's disease.
